body:
> I had a quick look and search and found this: #1015

It is related.

> So it won't still be able to perform a search from an external button without "hack" and getting the value from the input with JavaScript

Yes indeed. It's actually a regression from the #1015 issue. But then I'm wondering if we should have accepted that in the first place. Yes it's hacky when you want to be able to search using a button. But on the other hand it's inconsistent to update the url without searching. Since we update the URL based on the search state, and using the `search` event breaks the back button, I still think this sounds like a valid option.

WDYT? @vvo @iam4x
